st: Lil' Miss  Skeletons in the Closet
d: A mysterious note left on a grave may prove vital in solving a 12-year-old murder  exhaustive questioning of a bereaved mother leads investigators to discover the fate of her three dead children.

After U.S. Navy sailor disappears in 68, the Navy claims he went AWOL  but his sister works for over 30 years to prove that he was really killed  DNA from a cigarette butt helps detectives to unravel a 20-year-old case of rape and murder.
A detective tracks down a man who raped and murdered a 6-year-old girl 10 years earlier  police search for the killer of an 18-year-old hitchhiker.
In 1987, a young girl is found raped and strangled  in 1983, a young mother is raped and murdered at work.
Detectives suspect that several violent crimes are connected  a maintenance man finds a body in a bathroom.
In the 1980s, a suspected serial killer preyed on women in small towns located on the banks of the Mississippi River until the murders abruptly ceased and went unsolved.

In 1972, the body of Jody Loomis is found in the woods  thirty-four years later, the killer's DNA is recovered from Jody's old clothing, but it isn't matched until 2018 when genetic genealogy helps point to one suspect.
